start:
Send a picture, sticker, GIF, video or a link to one - it comes back as a video sticker, ready to go into a pack.

Or build the pack right here:
/newpack - name it, send files, /done
/mypacks - add stickers, change an emoji, delete a pack
/import - copy a pack made in @Stickers or another bot

/help for the rest.
